categories.main_business_segments: Performance Food Group Company (PFGC) operates through three primary business segments: Foodservice, Vistar, and Convenience. The Foodservice segment distributes a broad line of food and food-related products to independent and chain restaurants, as well as other institutional customers. Vistar specializes in distributing candy, snacks, beverages, and related items to vending, office coffee service, theater, retail, and hospitality channels. The Convenience segment distributes food, beverages, tobacco, and general merchandise to convenience stores and similar retail outlets across the U.S. and Canada.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: PFGC's core operations center on large-scale warehousing, logistics, and distribution, supported by integrated computer systems for order processing, inventory management, and route optimization. The company leverages advanced supply chain management, custom-cut meat and seafood processing at select facilities, and technology-enabled value-added services such as menu development and procurement analytics. Efficiency is further enhanced by on-board truck computers and fuel management technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: PFGC serves over 300,000 customer locations, including independent and chain restaurants, schools, healthcare facilities, business and industry sites, vending and office coffee distributors, theaters, retailers, convenience stores, drug stores, mass merchants, grocery stores, and specialty retailers. No single customer accounts for more than 10% of consolidated net sales, reflecting a highly diversified customer base across the food-away-from-home and convenience retail sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates 142 distribution centers across the United States and Canada, with Foodservice and Vistar primarily focused on the U.S. and the Convenience segment also operating in Canada. PFGC's distribution network provides national reach, with most customers located within 200-450 miles of a distribution center, enabling efficient service to both local and national accounts.
categories.supply_chain_position: PFGC operates as a downstream distributor, sourcing products from a wide range of suppliers and delivering them to end customers in the foodservice, vending, and convenience retail channels. The company acts as an intermediary between manufacturers/producers and a broad array of commercial customers, providing value-added distribution and logistics services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding sales to independent customers and proprietary Performance Brands, pursuing cross-segment synergies, geographic expansion, and operational efficiency through technology and network optimization. The company invests in productivity technologies, supply chain enhancements, and sustainability initiatives, such as reducing greenhouse gas emissions. Mergers and acquisitions, such as the Core-Mark acquisition, are also key to growth and diversification.
categories.revenue_model: PFGC generates revenue primarily through the sale and distribution of food, beverages, tobacco, and related products. Revenue is recognized at the point of delivery to customers, with pricing set by contract or at the time of order, often based on cost-plus or fixed markup models. The company also receives supplier rebates and promotional incentives, which reduce cost of goods sold.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: PFGC operates in a highly competitive industry, with major national competitors including Sysco and US Foods, as well as numerous regional and specialty distributors. PFGC differentiates itself through economies of scale, broad product assortment, proprietary brands, and extensive geographic coverage, positioning itself as one of the largest foodservice and convenience distributors in North America.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For fiscal year 2023, PFGC reported net sales of $57.3 billion, up 12.5% from the prior year, with Adjusted EBITDA of $1.36 billion and net income of $397 million. The company has demonstrated strong growth through acquisitions and organic expansion, with significant increases in both revenue and profitability over recent years. PFGC maintains a large asset base and substantial borrowing capacity, supporting ongoing investment and growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: PFGC emphasizes its ability to offer a broad and deep product assortment, including high-margin proprietary Performance Brands, and value-added services such as menu development, procurement expertise, and operational strategy support. Its national scale, efficient logistics, and local market knowledge enable reliable, timely delivery and tailored solutions for diverse customer needs, providing a competitive edge over smaller or less integrated distributors.
